case_number: 2024 INSC 90; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 1776 OF 2024 (@ SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (C) NO. 23017 OF 2023)
summary: Validity of No Confidence Motion against Sarpanch hinging on membership eligibility; appellant's entitlement to vote under Section 3, 4 Maharashtra Temporary Extension Act, 2023; requirement of Validity Certificate under Maharashtra Act, 2000 for reserved category elections; interpretation of mandatory versus directory provisions in Caste Certificate verification process; retrospective termination of election upon failure to submit Validity Certificate within twelve months; statutory scheme analysis of Panchayat elections and caste certification process
legal_provisions_cited: Maharashtra Temporary Extension of Period for Submitting Validity Certificate Act, 2023 s.3, s.4
Maharashtra Caste Certificate Act, 2000 s.3, s.4, s.6
final_judgment: To be determined based on whether appellant was entitled to protection under Temporary Extension Act, 2023; would validate election and vitiate No Confidence Motion if affirmative, otherwise motion stands carried.
